$comment: HAND-EDITED: keys cmux-next.json holds that are not Settings rows, because something other than the Settings schema reads them (a daemon, the Chief host, a page). The customize doctor (cmux-config schema::file_key) never calls one of these, or anything under it, an unknown setting, so it never tells the person their own tools' keys are typos. Add an entry when a tool reads a key of this file that has no row; name the reader so a removal finds it. A key nothing reads does not belong here: retire it in retired-keys.json instead.

keys.reader: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextApp/Focus/Keybindings (Keyboard Shortcuts writes and reads each binding here)
